composition_variation: Depict adult post-timeskip Nami walking along a sunlit coastal promenade in an opaque coral trench coat over a high-neck white top and loose cream trousers. Her orange hair lifts naturally in the breeze, and one hand rests on the coat lapel. Use clean fashion illustration, turquoise sea bands, pale terracotta architecture, and warm reflected light. Keep the confident pose entirely nonsexual. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
